title: Make the home page
summary: A page.tsx file defines what a route shows.
introduction: A page.tsx file defines what a route shows. Your task: Change the home-page greeting.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for make the home page

blocks.text: A page.tsx file defines what a route shows. In the app folder, page.tsx is the home page.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

blocks.code:
// app/page.tsx export default function Home(){return

Reading club

Pick a story today.

;}

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `app/page.tsx` is the App Router home route file.
The default component returns the HTML-like React markup for that route.

blocks.text: The home address shows the Reading club heading and paragraph.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A file must export its page component as default. Folder and file names decide the route.
